_notes.companion_trigger_range: Use 400–800 m. At 1000 m the expanded rings almost touch; above ~1100 m they overlap and multi-zone high-accuracy can misbehave.
_notes.high_accuracy: Owned by the Companion app (zone + trigger range). Do not force_on/force_off from HA — nourish_high_accuracy_gps.yaml was removed.
